_comment: How auto-generate-preview-image captures this site. The frame is the top of the homepage: the name with its lichen stop, the line under it, the two expertise columns, and the start of the Featured maps.
dataNote: Everything in the frame is Yili's own public profile as the live site shows it: his name, job title, expertise tags and two published map projects with their published figures. It holds no data about anyone else and nothing private.

steps.waitForFunction: document.fonts.status === 'loaded' && document.querySelectorAll('#hero-pills-geoscience .pill-tag').length > 0 && document.querySelectorAll('#hero-contact a').length > 0 && document.querySelectorAll('.flagship-media img').length >= 2 && [...document.querySelectorAll('.flagship-media img')].every(i => i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0)
